open_mathematics: Pursue a uniform small-y disk for traces reducing to zero at 3. At H=0 parametrize K=(z^2+z^-2)/2, P=z+1/z, Q=z-1/z, n0=(z^2-z^-2)/2. Compute the saturated generic minors over Q(z), beginning with the order-two fourth defect and then the sixth insertion and centers. The complementary valuation sector and unrestricted coverage are open.
